content.comment_body: Hello, I forgot the ADMIN password for two of my [product_name] modules [article_no]. How can I reset the admin password? I am unable to access admin mode on the [product_name] module. Thanks Greetings

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Navigate to Tools > Access Control > Control Operation from the [product_name] TD interface and assign a new password. This will overwrite the old password. Important reminders: - Ensure you check "Enable password protection for operation control" - Click "Apply"
